design.problem: Eleven of this extension's strings are rendered by XSLT templates that s9e compiles once and Flarum caches under the 'flarum.formatter' cache key for the whole install. The cache is not keyed on locale, so translating where the string is written freezes whichever locale warmed the cache into every future request for every reader.
design.mechanism: s9e XSL parameters. Declare a default at compile time ($config->rendering->parameters['L_X'] = 'English'; a TemplateParameterCollection, see s9e/TextFormatter src/Configurator/Rendering.php), reference it from the template as <xsl:value-of select="$L_X"/> or as {$L_X} inside an attribute value, and override it per request with Renderer::setParameters() (src/Renderer.php:126-143) from a render hook.
design.why_not_compile_time: Calling the translator inside Configure runs exactly once per cache warm, not once per request. It would produce a forum whose post chrome is in the language of whoever happened to hit the site after the last `php flarum cache:clear`.
design.why_not_js: These strings are inside server-rendered post HTML. A JS swap gives every reader a flash of English on every post, and gives crawlers, e-mail digests and no-JS readers English permanently. The parameter route is server-side and costs one translator lookup per locale per request.
steps: 1. Apply `template_patches` below to src/Configure.php. They are safe on their own: every parameter keeps its current English as its compile-time DEFAULT, so with nothing else applied the forum renders byte-identically to today.

3. Export the label list from Configure so Localize can walk it: promote the $labels array in community() to a `public const LABELS = ['SERIOUS' => 'serious', …]` mapping tag => locale key (the CSS modifier and the locale key are the same word for all 13 except HIQM => high_iq).

4. In extend.php, register it FIRST in the Formatter chain: `->render(Localize::class)` before ->render(ResolveQuoteLinks::class). Flarum\Formatter\Formatter::render() (core 1.8.5 src/Formatter/Formatter.php:113-121) calls every render callback with ($renderer, $context, $xml, $request) and only then $renderer->render($xml), so parameters set in a callback are in force for that render.
5. `php flarum cache:clear` — the parameter list is compiled into the cached renderer.
6. Verify with tests/render.php (vocab-*) and by loading a thread that contains a quote, a spoiler and an unimported mention in each locale.
risks: s9e's TemplateChecker runs over every template at compile time. Parameters in text nodes and in title/aria-label attribute values are expected to pass — its restrictions on dynamic values are for URL, CSS and JS contexts (DisallowUnsafeDynamicURL / DynamicCSS / DynamicJS) — but this has NOT been executed here: there is no vendor tree and no PHP on this box, so it is reasoned from the s9e source, not measured. If a template is rejected the failure is a thrown exception at cache-warm time, which is loud rather than silent.

The JS preview renderer (Flarum enables $configurator->enableJavaScript() with exports = ['preview']) gets the compile-time DEFAULTS, i.e. English, unless setParameter is also called client-side. That affects only the composer's live preview of a post being written, not any rendered post; fixing it means reaching flarum.core.s9e from JS and is worth a separate decision.

<?php

namespace Local\Format;

use s9e\TextFormatter\Renderer;
use Symfony\Contracts\Translation\TranslatorInterface;

/**
 * Locale for the chrome the XSLT templates render inside post content.
 *
 * The formatter is compiled once and cached for the whole install, so the
 * strings in Configure's templates cannot be translated where they are written:
 * whichever locale happened to warm the cache would be frozen into every future
 * request. s9e's answer is XSL parameters — declared with a default at compile
 * time, overridden per render — and Flarum hands every render hook the Renderer
 * itself before it calls render(), which is the seam this uses.
 *
 * Memoised per locale: a discussion page renders ~20 posts through the same
 * hook and the catalogue lookup is not free.
 */
class Localize
{
    /** @var array<string,array<string,string>> locale => param name => text */
    private array $cache = [];

    public function __construct(private TranslatorInterface $translator)
    {
    }

    public function __invoke(Renderer $renderer, $context, string $xml): string
    {
        $renderer->setParameters($this->strings());

        return $xml;
    }

    private function strings(): array
    {
        $locale = method_exists($this->translator, 'getLocale') ? $this->translator->getLocale() : '';

        if (isset($this->cache[$locale])) {
            return $this->cache[$locale];
        }

        $t = fn (string $key): string => $this->translator->trans('local-looksmax-format.'.$key);

        $params = [
            'L_SPOILER' => $t('forum.post.spoiler'),
            'L_SPOILER_HIDDEN' => $t('forum.post.spoiler_hidden'),
            'L_REPLY_GATED' => $t('forum.post.reply_gated'),
            'L_DELETED' => $t('forum.post.deleted'),
            'L_UNIMPORTED' => $t('forum.post.unimported_member'),
            'L_QUOTE_SAID' => $t('forum.quote.said'),
            'L_QUOTE_MOCK' => $t('forum.quote.mock'),
            'L_QUOTE_JUMP' => $t('forum.quote.jump'),
        ];

        foreach (Configure::LABELS as $tag => $key) {
            $params['L_LABEL_'.$tag] = $t('forum.label.'.$key);
        }

        return $this->cache[$locale] = $params;
    }
}
